title: Heights of families indexed by ℓ-adic embeddings, the product formula, and the height of one Gram determinant
summary: A family y of complex numbers indexed by the pairs (ℓ, ι) of a prime ℓ and a ring isomorphism ι : ℂ → ℚ̄_ℓ has height at most c (HeightLe c y) when one nonzero H ∈ ℂ, a real α and reals e(ℓ) bound |σH| ≤ e^α for all σ ∈ Aut(ℂ), ‖ι(H·y(ℓ,ι))‖_ℓ ≤ exp e(ℓ), and α + Σ_{ℓ<M} e(ℓ) ≤ c for all large M. Height bounds are monotone, add under pointwise products and powers, and the product formula for ℚ (applied to the norm of H) gives HeightLe.nonneg: a bound for the constant family 1 is ≥ 0. The second file proves the linear algebra behind the lower bound: a Fourier/positive-type estimate for singular minors (card_mul_sum_det_le), a Hilbert–Schmidt inequality (finrank_sub_le_re_inner_dyadSum), the greedy 'few translates' lemma (exists_few_translates), basis extension, and one_determinant, which bounds the height of the ratio of squared volumes normDet(u_θ)²/normDet(u_o)² by α + 2δ + k·g from integral recombinations at every ℓ-adic place.

members.name: PrimePadicIso
members.text: PrimePadicIso is the type of pairs (ℓ, ι) of a prime number ℓ (an element of Nat.Primes) and a ring isomorphism ι : ℂ → ℚ̄_ℓ from the complex numbers onto Mathlib's algebraic closure PadicAlgCl ℓ of the field ℚ_ℓ of ℓ-adic numbers (a dependent pair, Σ ℓ, ℂ ≃+* PadicAlgCl ℓ). Families of complex numbers indexed by it are the objects whose heights are bounded in this unit. (Such isomorphisms exist only by choice: both fields are algebraically closed of characteristic 0 and of the cardinality of the continuum; the source never constructs one.)

members.name: HeightLe
members.text: For a real number c and a family y : PrimePadicIso → ℂ (one complex number y(ℓ, ι) for every prime ℓ and every ring isomorphism ι : ℂ → ℚ̄_ℓ), HeightLe c y ('y has height at most c') holds when there exist a complex number H, a real number α and a function e : ℕ → ℝ such that (i) H ≠ 0; (ii) |σ(H)| ≤ exp(α) for every ring automorphism σ of ℂ; (iii) ‖ι(H·y(ℓ, ι))‖_ℓ ≤ exp(e(ℓ)) for every (ℓ, ι) ∈ PrimePadicIso, where ‖·‖_ℓ is the norm of ℚ̄_ℓ extending the ℓ-adic norm of ℚ_ℓ (‖ℓ‖_ℓ = 1/ℓ); (iv) α + Σ_{ℓ < M, ℓ prime} e(ℓ) ≤ c for all sufficiently large natural numbers M (eventually along M → ∞). Nothing requires e ≥ 0, so c may be negative a priori; HeightLe.nonneg excludes that for the constant family 1.

members.statement_lean:
lemma log_product_formula {M} {q : ℚ} (h : q.num.natAbs ⊔ q.den < M) : log q + ∑ p ∈ range M with
  p.Prime, log (padicNorm p q) = 0
members.text: Product formula for ℚ, in logarithms. For every natural number M and every rational number q with max(|numerator of q|, denominator of q) < M: log q + Σ_{p < M, p prime} log |q|_p = 0, where log is Lean's real logarithm of the real number q (log x = log|x| for x ≠ 0, log 0 = 0) and |q|_p = padicNorm p q is the p-adic absolute value (p^(−v_p(q)) for q ≠ 0, and 0 for q = 0). For q ≠ 0 this is the product formula |q|·Π_p |q|_p = 1, the primes below M including every prime that divides the numerator or the denominator; for q = 0 both terms are 0 by the conventions.

lemma card_mul_sum_det_le [Fintype k] (π : G →* GL n k) (A : _ → Matrix n m k) {Θ} (h0 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ Θ

Let k be a finite field with q = |k| elements, n and m finite index types, G a finite group, π : G → GL_n(k) a group homomorphism, A : Bool → Mat_{n×m}(k) a pair of n×m matrices A(true), A(false), Θ : G → ℝ with Θ(s) ≥ 0 for all s (h0) and of positive type through a family u : G → H in a complex inner product space H, ⟨u(a), u(b)⟩ = Θ(a⁻¹b) for all a, b (hu), and Y ≥ 0 real (hY). Then q·Σ_{s ∈ G : det(A(true)ᵀ·π(s)·A(false)) = 0} Θ(s) ≤ 2·Σ_{s∈G} Θ(s) + q^{|m|}·√(q^{|n|})·Y. lemma finrank_sub_le_re_inner_dyadSum [FiniteDimensional ℂ H] (P : EuclideanSpace ℂ n →ₗ[ℂ] H) (R :
  End ℂ H) (U A : Submodule ℂ _) {ε} (k : ∑ x, ‖(P.adjoint ∘ₗ P - 1) (.single x 1)‖ ≤ ε)
  (h : ∀ v ∈ U, P v - R (P v) ∈ A) : finrank ℂ U - ε - ∑ x, ‖R (P (.single x 1))‖ ^ 2 ≤
  re ⟪dyadSum b (P <| .single · 1), dyadSum b (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ A ·)⟫_ℂ

Let α, δ, g be real numbers with |σ(det Gram(u_o∘x))| ≤ exp(α) for every ring automorphism σ of ℂ (hα), Gram(v) = (⟨v_s, v_t⟩)_{s,t∈S}. Let γ : PrimePadicIso → ℂ with γ(ι) ≠ 0 for all ι (γ0) and HeightLe g (ι ↦ |γ(ι)|⁻²) (hγ); let e : ℕ → ℝ with Σ_{l∈U} e(l) ≤ δ for every finite set U of natural numbers (he); let Λ assign to every (ℓ, ι) ∈ PrimePadicIso and every ring homomorphism j : ℂ → ℂ_ℓ a subset Λ(ι, j) ⊆ H(θ(ι)); and let k ∈ ℕ. Assume (w): for all ι, j, all x' ∈ Λ(ι, j∘conj) and y' ∈ Λ(ι, j), ‖j(⟨x', y'⟩)‖_ℓ ≤ 1; and (l): for all ι = (ℓ, ι) and j there is a complex S×S matrix m with exp(−e(ℓ))·‖j(γ(ι))‖^k ≤ ‖j(det m)‖ and Σ_{l∈S} m_{il}·u_{θ(ι)}(x_l) ∈ Λ(ι, j) for every i ∈ S. Then HeightLe (α + 2δ + k·g) (ι ↦ normDet(u_{θ(ι)})² / normDet(u_o)²), where normDet(u) = √det(u*u) ≥ 0 is the volume factor of a linear map (Mathlib's LinearMap.normDet), the quotient taken in ℂ. imports.name: isAlgebraic_of_padic
imports.lean: lemma isAlgebraic_of_padic {x c} (h : ∀ ι, ‖complexToCp (p := 2) ι x‖ ≤ c) : IsAlgebraic ℚ x := by
imports.text: If a complex number x satisfies ‖complexToCp ι x‖ ≤ c, with one real bound c, for every ring isomorphism ι : ℂ → ℚ̄_2 (complexToCp ι: ι followed by the inclusion ℚ̄_2 ⊆ ℂ_2), then x is algebraic over ℚ.

imports.name: exists_ringEquiv_extend
imports.lean:
lemma exists_ringEquiv_extend {L K} [Field L] [IsAlgClosed L] [CommRing K] [Countable K]
    (e : #ℂ = #L) (f : K →+* ℂ) (g : K →+* L) (hf : (⇑f).Injective := by apply RingHom.injective)
    (hg : (⇑g).Injective := by apply RingHom.injective) : ∃ σ : ℂ ≃+* L, ∀ a, σ (f a) = g a := by
imports.text: Let L be an algebraically closed field with #ℂ = #L (e), K a countable commutative ring, f : K → ℂ and g : K → L injective ring homomorphisms (the injectivity hypotheses hf, hg default to a proof by RingHom.injective, which applies when K is a field). Then there is a ring isomorphism σ : ℂ → L with σ(f(a)) = g(a) for all a ∈ K.
